frame.axes: machine body axes: x forward = +Z_cad, y left = +X_cad, z up = +Y_cad
frame.pose: CAD pose; legs in the retracted state (CAD + legs.<leg>.retracted_offset_from_cad_m along +z); auger (drive + tool) at the CAD position, the loader adds superstructure.auger_travel_m along +z

attach_rules.superstructure: shape frame = body COG frame translated by -superstructure.mass_properties.com_m (+ auger_travel_m z if moves_with_auger)
attach_rules.leg: shape frame = leg moving-part COG frame translated by -legs.<leg>.moving_part.com_m (retracted COM, independent of the extension)
